subject: Next steps after discovery — procurement restrictions (card-only / no PO)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lucas Harper <lucas.harper@edgebio.com>, Sana Ahmed <sana.ahmed@edgebio.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + ask: procurement path and pilot commercial model

Hi Lucas / Sana,

Thanks again for the conversation today — appreciated the clarity on your evaluation goals and the technical constraints on data residency. Quick recap and two asks so we keep momentum: 

1) Pilot scope: 3-week integration proof-of-value (2 endpoints: generate + embeddings), expected monthly spend during pilot ~$6k.
2) Success criteria: latency < 350ms p95 for 2k QPS bursts and mapping to 3 internal prompts for regression checks.
3) Procurement: you mentioned procurement will not accept POs for vendor pilots and prefer corporate card or a marketplace purchase.

As next steps:
- Can you confirm whether EdgeBio prefers a marketplace listing (Azure/GCP marketplace) or a one-off charge by card for the pilot?
- Can procurement share any spend threshold or prepay requirement that would stop a card transaction?

I attached a short SOW and pricing summary (pilot pricing, seat of dedicated support). If procurement needs an internal purchase order we can discuss an exception path, but we want to avoid slowing the timeline if card/marketplace is acceptable.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call with procurement next week to align.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW_EdgeBio_Pilot_v1.pdf (PDF, 92KB); Redwood_Pricing_Summary.xlsx (XLSX, 38KB)

From: Lucas Harper <lucas.harper@edgebio.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sana Ahmed <sana.ahmed@edgebio.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: procurement path and pilot commercial model

Karthik — thanks for the recap and the materials. Two clarifications from procurement side: 

1) EdgeBio policy: for any vendor engagement that touches customer data we do not raise POs for pilots — our central procurement team refuses POs for non-contracted pilot work. We have to use the corporate card or purchase via an approved cloud marketplace (if available).
2) We cannot prepay more than 30 days in advance for vendor services unless the vendor is on our insurance/contracting whitelist (which requires a fully executed MSA).

For the pilot size you mention (~$6k/month), procurement prefers a charge on the corporate card. They are not opposed to a marketplace purchase but EdgeBio does not see Redwood listed in our Azure marketplace procurement catalog today.

If you need a signature on a short SOW to proceed on card, we can sign and return. If there are compliance questions, I can introduce you to our security contact — but that will add a week. Let me know the cleanest path from Redwood’s side that avoids PO paperwork.

— Lucas
Director, Platform Engineering | EdgeBio Therapeutics

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: EdgeBio — procurement is card-only for pilot (no PO) — need commercial / finance workaround

Team, looping you in. Prospect EdgeBio (deal RDW-3457) confirmed procurement will not accept POs for pilots — they require card or marketplace. Pilot expected spend ~6k/mo (3-week POV). They can sign a short SOW.

Questions / asks: 
- Finance (Monica): can we accept a corporate card charge and invoice normally, or do we need a billing-only workaround (pre-authorized card capture, or one-off invoice recorded as card)? Any risks on our AR side for a card-only pilot where the customer says they cannot prepay?
- Legal (Markus): is a signed SOW without MSA adequate for a one-off pilot if we default to card payment (no PO)? What minimal terms do we require for data handling?
- Sales Ops (Marissa): would you approve a short-term card-only flow for a pilot up to $25k without full contract? Or do we need a temporary amendment to our standard terms?

Context: EdgeBio is a mid-market biotech prospect with potential enterprise upside; we want to avoid losing momentum over paperwork. I attached the SOW + pricing.

Proposed interim solution: allow card payment for initial pilot, require signed SOW and statements around data handling, then start MSA/contract process in parallel — escalate to legal for minimal clause insertion. If finance needs additional guardrails (pre-auth amount, deposit), propose 30-day net invoice plus card on file.

Appreciate quick thoughts — procurement said they can charge card as early as next Tue if we confirm path.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lucas Harper <lucas.harper@edgebio.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Internal: EdgeBio — procurement is card-only for pilot (no PO) — need commercial / finance workaround

Karthik — thanks for pulling this together and for the clear options. I spoke briefly with Finance and Legal this morning. Summary and path forward: 

1) Approved interim approach: Card-only pilot up to $25,000 total ARR (covers their stated pilot). Requirements: signed one-page SOW, Redwood standard pilot terms addendum, and card capture/authorization on file. No prepay required beyond card authorization.

2) Legal asks: include minimal data handling paragraph (no storage beyond session unless agreed) and limitation of liability carveout consistent with our pilot terms. Markus to drop a one-paragraph addendum this afternoon.

3) Finance asks for GL code and customer billing contact; they prefer to record as "card charge (misc revenue)" and will not create a PO on our side. Monica to provide payment instructions and temporary billing flow.

Karthik — please: 
- Send the one-page SOW (attached) back to Lucas with the note that this meets our pilot policy and we can charge the corporate card.
- Ask procurement to confirm card holder name, last 4, and billing email so Finance can complete the charge.

Lucas — appreciate the flexibility. When you confirm, we will send the DocuSign link for the SOW and finalize provisioning.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: SOW_EdgeBio_Pilot_v1.pdf
